No record of CRA-to-furnisher transmission timing or content

determinations.rationale: The packet does not indicate whether the CRA transmitted notice to the furnisher within 5 business days or what information was forwarded; the case was routed to manual review before that step is documented.

material_facts.fact: Customer claims two accounts are 'not mine' and involve identity theft
Police incident number provided but no completed identity-theft report or affidavit
Bank routed to manual review pending additional ID-theft documentation

determinations.rationale: The dispute was uploaded to the bank (potentially a furnisher direct dispute), but the consumer did not supply a completed identity-theft report/affidavit, and the bank could not match documents to the account-opening file. Whether the dispute meets the qualifying-direct-dispute documentation requirement or warrants a frivolous/irrelevant determination notice has not been resolved; the case is pending manual review.

Bank explicitly routed the case to manual review

determinations.rationale: Identity-theft evidence is plausible but incomplete (no affidavit/ID-theft report), primary source documents are missing, and the institution explicitly routed the case to manual review—each independently triggers human review.
